source.title: Amendments to the Motions Approved (September 2020)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

After recent voting by WCA Staff Members, the proposed amendments to the Motions have been approved by a good majority. The amendment of the Motions followed Motion 13.2019.1 now called [Motion 13.2020.1: Amendments of Bylaws and Motions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/13.2020.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Motions.pdf) and a summary of the included changes has been compiled below:

[Motion 04.2020.1 - Board of Directors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/04.2020.1%20-%20Board%20of%20Directors.pdf) - Change WCA Staff to Voting Members.
[Motion 07.2020.1 - Registered Speedcubers](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/07.2020.1%20-%20Registered%20Speedcubers.pdf) - Changes to match Bylaws regarding resignation of membership and current practices regarding anonymization.
[Motion 08.2020.1 - Delegates](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/08.2020.1%20-%20Delegates.pdf) - Add requirement for knowledge of WCA Policies
[Motion 08.2020.2 - Trainee Delegates](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/08.2020.2%20-%20Trainee%20Delegates.pdf) - Add requirement for knowledge of WCA Policies and reword tasks which they cannot do alone.
[Motion 09.2020.1 - Senior Delegates](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2020.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) - Add required approval from the Board to certain points to match current practices and clarification of regions without seniors.
[Motion 10.2020.0 - Committees and Teams](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) - Clarification regarding teams without leaders. Minor grammatical fix
[Motion 10.2020.4 - Regulation Committee](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.4%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf) - Transfer of tasks which are normally handled by WQAC to the Quality Assurance Motion
[Motion 10.2020.5 - Financial Committee](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.5%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf) - Add collection of dues as a responsibility of the WFC
[Motion 10.2020.6 - Data Protection Committee](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.6%20-%20Data%20Protection%20Committee.pdf) - Minor grammatical fix
[Motion 10.2020.7 - Ethics Committee](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.7%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf) - Add Registered Speedcubers as persons who must cooperate with investigations by the WEC
[Motion 13.2020.1 - Amendments of Motions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/13.2020.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Motions.pdf) - Remove mention of the Bylaws to avoid contradiction with the process already outlined in the Bylaws
[Motion 14.2020.1 - Amendment of Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/14.2020.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Regulations.pdf) - Remove arbitrary 2 week period from announcement that Regulations come into effect
[Motion 16.2020.1 - Disputes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/16.2020.1%20-%20Disputes.pdf) - Change some “must” to “should” to match current practices
[Motion 20.2020.0 - Councils](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2020.0%20-%20Councils.pdf) - Change of submitting a message to submitting a resignation and clarification of councils without a leader

translation.title: 议案修订获通过（2020 年 9 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

经过近期 WCA 工作人员投票，拟议的议案修订以明显多数获得通过。本次修订依照议案 13.2019.1 进行，该议案现称[《议案 13.2020.1：章程及议案修订》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/13.2020.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Motions.pdf)。修改内容概述如下：

* [议案 04.2020.1——董事会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/04.2020.1%20-%20Board%20of%20Directors.pdf)：将“WCA 工作人员”改为“有表决权的会员”。
* [议案 07.2020.1——注册速拧选手](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/07.2020.1%20-%20Registered%20Speedcubers.pdf)：调整内容，使其与章程中退出会员资格的规定及现行匿名化做法一致。
* [议案 08.2020.1——代表](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/08.2020.1%20-%20Delegates.pdf)：增加了解 WCA 政策的要求。
* [议案 08.2020.2——实习代表](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/08.2020.2%20-%20Trainee%20Delegates.pdf)：增加了解 WCA 政策的要求，并重新表述不得独立执行的任务。
* [议案 09.2020.1——高级代表](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2020.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf)：为部分事项增加董事会批准要求，与现行做法一致；并明确没有高级代表的地区如何处理。
* [议案 10.2020.0——委员会与团队](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)：明确没有负责人的团队如何处理，并作小幅语法修正。
* [议案 10.2020.4——规则委员会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.4%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf)：将通常由 WQAC 处理的任务移入《质量保证委员会议案》。
* [议案 10.2020.5——财务委员会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.5%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf)：将收取会费加入 WFC 的职责。
* [议案 10.2020.6——数据保护委员会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.6%20-%20Data%20Protection%20Committee.pdf)：小幅语法修正。
* [议案 10.2020.7——道德委员会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.7%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf)：将注册速拧选手列入必须配合 WEC 调查的人员范围。
* [议案 13.2020.1——议案修订](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/13.2020.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Motions.pdf)：删除对章程的提及，以免与章程已规定的程序相冲突。
* [议案 14.2020.1——规则修订](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/14.2020.1%20-%20Amendments%20of%20Regulations.pdf)：取消规则从公告到生效必须间隔 2 周的固定要求。
* [议案 16.2020.1——争议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/16.2020.1%20-%20Disputes.pdf)：将部分“必须”改为“应当”，与现行做法一致。
* [议案 20.2020.0——理事会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2020.0%20-%20Councils.pdf)：将“提交消息”改为“提交辞呈”，并明确没有负责人的理事会如何处理。
notes: 原文首段对 13.2020.1 的名称仍含 Bylaws，后文明确删去；按原文各处分别保留，未擅自统一。
